我们在[From.GetName]上找到了一个我方的旧探测器。这些年来它一直保持运作，还试图将数据传送到母星上去。这是我们往日艰苦奋斗的纪念碑，也代表了昔日我们冲破行星枷锁的愿望。

我们应该继续调查这些异常现象。这样一定会获得新的知识和科技的吧。
texts.en:
We found one of our old probes on [From.GetName]. It has somehow kept intact all these years and is still trying to send data to our homeworld. It stands as a testament to our past struggles, and our wish to flee our Planet's bounds.

We should continue to investigate these sorts of anomalies whenever we get the chance. It will most assuredly grant us new knowledge and technology.

label.en: The divine surely has more in store.

label.zh: 我们的努力终于有了回报。
label.en: Our efforts have finally paid off.
